_about: v2.5 plan 06 J1 authoring hold-out (the memory-pairs-holdout rule). Five Spanish rows, labelled 2026-09-26 and committed BEFORE the a16 fix commit, with no model answer read for any of them. Same scoring as authoring.json (validity, opShape). Scored in both x2 re-runs of `so-role-calibration.mts run --role authoring --holdout` and reported beside the fixture score; they never enter or change the fixture floors. A miss in either run turns the recommended-config row into 'fixture floors met; generalisation not shown'. Drafts resolve by name from authoring.json. Do not edit a label after a run; add a row instead.
